title: Attach Procedural IFC Materials to a Schependomlaan Model
description: Loads the Schependomlaan SceneModel + DataModel (~1500 IFC objects spanning IfcWall, IfcSlab, IfcCovering, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcRailing, IfcStair, IfcBeam, IfcColumn, IfcMember and more), then uses attachSceneModelMaterials to bind a procedurally-painted PBR material to every object based on its IFC type.
